# MATA Dashboard

> Lightweight PHP monitoring dashboard for servers and applications

MATA is a self-hosted PHP dashboard that monitors servers and applications through MATA Node agents. Coding agents installing it start with the agent runbook; every operator command (bin/mata) prints JSON with --json and reports through its exit code.


## Getting started

- [Install with a coding agent](https://docs.mata.sh/guides/agent-install/index.md): Runbook for coding agents, non-interactive install and checks
- [Docker quickstart](https://docs.mata.sh/guides/quickstart-docker/index.md): Docker install, unattended setup variables
- [Quick start](https://docs.mata.sh/guides/quickstart/index.md): Native install
- [Add your first server](https://docs.mata.sh/guides/first-server/index.md): Connect a MATA Node
